description_en: Deletes a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 删除网络型负载均衡实例
name: DeleteLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: Performs a dry run without deleting the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): Sends a regular request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value of this parameter on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
